note: Bindings pass. The template corpus let the model reach a training nll of 0.1557 while learning no binding at all: facts sat inside ~80% predictable prose, so the average loss was dominated by templates and the gradient on the lookup was diluted. This corpus is one line per binding and nothing else -- 'S: <subject> -> <answer>' -- so about half the bytes can only be predicted by looking the binding up. Same shape as the quality pass (86,465 parameters), 32 bindings, 256 tokens per update, state reset every 2048 tokens so the cold-start regime the probes use is inside the training distribution.
purpose: Make the binding learnable and measure it end to end; see docs/PROMPT_RESPONSE_PRETRAINING.md section 8.6
